objective: Audit the primary extremal edge bound, its order-one convention and strict/parity-sensitive girth translations; derive an explicitly conditional size-growth improvement without upgrading the root.

atomic_claims.text: Conditional on T3, n>=2, girth>=g and average degree <3-3/q(g), with q(g) the least odd integer >=g, suffice for MC.
A simple graph with minimum degree >=3 and girth >=2r+1 has at least 3*2^r-2 vertices; combined with the structural suppression lemma and T3 this gives a sufficient MC threshold.
Conditional on T3, for 2<d<3 on n>=2 a sufficient girth is 4r+1 whenever r>=1 and 2^r>=1/(3-d)+2/3.
The 2005 primary source includes order-one immune ABC graphs, supporting nonempty shores but not resolving whether the separate OPG quantifier intended to exclude K1.
